items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: An inline conversation marker - status lines, system notes, and labelled dividers. 3 variants, Base UI render-polymorphic.

meta.whenToUse: Annotate a thread inline - a merged/status line, a date divider, or a small action row.
meta.whenNotToUse: A standalone status chip outside a conversation (use Badge) or a full banner (use Alert).

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Layout primitives for a conversation row - avatar anchoring, content column, header/footer slots, start/end alignment. Server-safe.

meta.whenToUse: Lay out a chat/AI conversation row - compose Avatar, Bubble, and Marker as children.
meta.whenNotToUse: A non-conversational list row - use a plain layout or Data List / Settings Row.

items.name: bubble
items.title: Bubble
items.description: A chat speech bubble - 7 token-driven variants (incl. brand-tinted), start/end alignment, interactive content, and a floating reactions chip.

meta.whenToUse: The speech surface inside a Message - sent/received styling, reactions, interactive bubbles.
meta.whenNotToUse: Non-conversational callouts - use Alert or Card.

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: A virtualised, auto-scrolling conversation viewport - pins to the latest message, preserves position on prepend, tracks the anchor, and a floating scroll-to-end button.

meta.whenToUse: A live chat/AI thread that must auto-scroll, virtualise long histories, and offer a jump-to-latest control.
meta.whenNotToUse: A short, static list that fits without scrolling - use Message inside a plain container or Scroll Area.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file chip / thumbnail card for chat and message-compose surfaces - media slot, name + meta, uploading/error/complete states, remove/download actions.

meta.whenToUse: A file attached to a chat message or a message-compose input - a chip/thumbnail with name, size, upload progress, and a remove action.
meta.whenNotToUse: A generic file upload/drop zone with no chat context - reach for Empty (bordered drop zone) or a form Field instead.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Trigger an action. 15 variants × 8 sizes, with loading + Base UI Button semantics.

meta.whenToUse: Any clickable action — submit, confirm, destructive, etc.
meta.whenNotToUse: Navigation to a URL — use a link styled as a button (variant=link).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A compact status or label chip. 3 variants × semantic colors × 4 sizes, with dot, loading, and icon support.

meta.whenToUse: Label or annotate status, counts, or categories — e.g. Active, Beta, 3 New.
meta.whenNotToUse: Anything clickable — use a Button; a Badge is a non-interactive label.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A status banner — five semantic variants, an optional icon, and an optional dismiss button.

meta.whenToUse: Persistent, in-page status messages — info, success, warning, or error context tied to surrounding content.
meta.whenNotToUse: Transient feedback after a user action — use a toast instead.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A styled Base UI input — all input types, Field state data attributes, error and disabled states, focus-visible ring, and optional prefix/suffix addons.

meta.whenToUse: Single-line text entry — email, password, search, URL/slug with a domain prefix, numbers, etc.
meta.whenNotToUse: Multi-line text (use a textarea) or choosing from fixed options (use a select/radio).

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A form-field wrapper — label, inline label action, description, and error/success message, built on Base UI Field.

meta.whenToUse: Wrap any form control to give it a label, description, and accessible error/success message with auto-wired ARIA.
meta.whenNotToUse: A bare control with its own label already wired — Field is for the label+message+a11y scaffold.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal overlay — five sizes, a header/footer layout, focus trapping, and animated enter/exit.

meta.whenToUse: Modal interactions requiring full attention — confirmations, focused forms, destructive-action prompts.
meta.whenNotToUse: Non-blocking feedback (Toast), inline contextual content (Popover/Tooltip), or full-screen mobile scroll (Drawer/Sheet).

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A dropdown for choosing one option — trigger with value and chevron, grouped scrollable popup, full keyboard navigation, animated enter/exit.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing a single value from a fixed, known set — fonts, timezones, statuses — especially long/grouped lists.
meta.whenNotToUse: Boolean on/off (Switch), few inline options (radios), multi-select, or free-text/async search (combobox).

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A filterable, keyboard-navigable listbox behind a text input — type-to-filter, grouped items, async status, and a multi-select chip mode.

meta.whenToUse: Choosing from a large or dynamic set that benefits from typing to narrow it down — searchable pickers, tag/label multi-select, async-loaded results.
meta.whenNotToUse: A small, fixed set with no need to search (Select), boolean on/off (Switch), or a few always-visible options (radios/checkboxes).

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A floating label on hover or focus — smart shared delay, rich content, optional keyboard hints, collision-aware positioning.

meta.whenToUse: Short supplementary labels on icon buttons, toolbar actions, and controls — optionally with a shortcut hint.
meta.whenNotToUse: Interactive content (links/buttons) or essential information — a tooltip isn't reliably reachable; use a Popover.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu of actions triggered by a button — items, submenus, separators, labels, shortcuts, and checkbox/radio selections.

meta.whenToUse: A button-triggered menu of actions — row actions (edit/duplicate/delete), account menus, view toggles.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single-value form input (Select), page navigation (nav/menubar), or a persistent always-visible action list.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Layered content sections — line or pill variants, optional icons and count badges, horizontal or vertical, full keyboard navigation.

meta.whenToUse: Organize related content into peer sections the user switches between in place; count badges surface pending items.
meta.whenNotToUse: Sequential multi-step flows (stepper), single-select form input (radio/select), or sections that must be visible at once.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A borders-only content surface — no shadows, with composable header, content, and footer parts.

meta.whenToUse: Group related content into a bordered surface — summaries, plan tiles, settings sections.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single standalone values or page layout regions; never nest cards or add shadows.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A styled keyboard-key indicator — OS-aware modifier glyphs, a keys array, and small sizes.

meta.whenToUse: Display a keyboard shortcut or key in menus, tooltips, command palettes, help text.
meta.whenNotToUse: As an interactive control or to capture keystrokes — Kbd is presentational only.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A token-driven loading placeholder — line, circle, rect, card shapes, configurable count, reduced-motion-aware pulse.

meta.whenToUse: Reserve layout space while content loads to avoid layout shift.
meta.whenNotToUse: Indeterminate progress with no known layout (Spinner) or determinate tasks (progress bar).

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate loading indicator — a spinning icon inheriting currentColor, four sizes, role=status by default.

meta.whenToUse: Signal an indeterminate, in-progress load — inside a button or a loading region.
meta.whenNotToUse: Showing measurable progress (progress bar) or a skeleton-able layout (skeleton).

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A thin rule dividing content — horizontal or vertical, decorative by default, built on Base UI.

meta.whenToUse: Divide distinct sections of content, menus, or toolbars.
meta.whenNotToUse: Pure spacing between elements — use margin/gap.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: A zero-data placeholder — icon, title, description, actions, with intent tints and an optional dashed border.

meta.whenToUse: When a list, table, or panel has no content — communicate the zero state and offer the next action.
meta.whenNotToUse: While loading (skeleton/spinner) or for transient post-action feedback (toast).

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A binary (or tri-state) toggle — checked, unchecked, indeterminate, disabled, built on Base UI Checkbox.

meta.whenToUse: Toggle a single option on/off, accept terms, or drive a 'select all' parent with indeterminate.
meta.whenNotToUse: Mutually-exclusive choices (RadioGroup); instant self-saving settings (Switch).

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off toggle for instant, self-saving binary settings — built on Base UI Switch.

meta.whenToUse: Settings that apply instantly — notifications, dark mode, feature flags.
meta.whenNotToUse: Inside a form needing a Submit step — use a Checkbox.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A circular user/entity image with an initials fallback, five sizes, and an overlapping AvatarGroup stack.

meta.whenToUse: Represent a user/entity with a photo, falling back to initials — alone or stacked in a group.
meta.whenNotToUse: When you must fetch/resolve the image source — presentational; resolve R2/CDN keys app-side.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A styled native label for form controls — htmlFor association, disabled dimming, optional required indicator.

meta.whenToUse: Label any form control — pair via htmlFor/id or by wrapping. Use required for mandatory fields.
meta.whenNotToUse: As a heading, or when you need a full field layout — use Field.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A styled native textarea for multi-line text — error/disabled states, a focus-visible ring, and an optional auto-grow mode.

meta.whenToUse: Multi-line free text — descriptions, comments, messages, notes.
meta.whenNotToUse: Single-line entry (input), rich text (editor), or fixed options (select).

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A set of mutually-exclusive options — single selection, arrow-key navigation, disabled, built on Base UI Radio Group.

meta.whenToUse: 2–5 mutually-exclusive choices all visible at once.
meta.whenNotToUse: Many options (Select) or non-exclusive multi-select (Checkboxes).

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Pick a number or a [from, to] range from a continuous track — keyboard accessible, with optional steps. Built on Base UI Slider.

meta.whenToUse: An imprecise value over a bounded range — volume, brightness, a price filter.
meta.whenNotToUse: Exact values or large/open ranges (number input); on/off (Switch).

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button that can be pressed on or off — bold/italic, mute, pin.

meta.whenToUse: A binary on/off control that persists — bold/italic, mute, pin.
meta.whenNotToUse: One-shot action (Button) or mutually-exclusive options (ToggleGroup/RadioGroup).

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Joined toggle buttons sharing one selection — single or multiple, variants/sizes, horizontal/vertical, full keyboard navigation.

meta.whenToUse: Related toggle buttons sharing one selection — alignment, or multi-select formatting.
meta.whenNotToUse: Navigation between views (Tabs) or a single on/off control (Toggle/Switch).

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A stack of collapsible sections — single or multiple open, animated height, a rotating chevron, full keyboard support.

meta.whenToUse: Group related content into collapsible sections — FAQs, settings groups.
meta.whenNotToUse: Hiding critical content, or sequential steps (stepper).

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A single toggleable open/close region with an animated height, built on Base UI Collapsible.

meta.whenToUse: A single show/hide region — extra detail, an optional form section, 'read more'.
meta.whenNotToUse: Several coordinated sections where one opens at a time — use Accordion.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A click-triggered floating panel for arbitrary content — positioning, an optional arrow, and built-in dismiss.

meta.whenToUse: Lightweight optional content tied to a trigger — a settings form, a picker, extra detail.
meta.whenNotToUse: Content that must block the page (Dialog) or a tooltip's worth of text (Tooltip).

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal confirmation dialog with four semantic intents — non-dismissable, forcing a deliberate Cancel/confirm choice.

meta.whenToUse: Destructive/irreversible confirmations (delete, discard, reset) — backdrop non-dismissable.
meta.whenNotToUse: Routine dismissable modal content — use Dialog.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A determinate horizontal progress bar for measurable, ongoing tasks — built on Base UI Progress.

meta.whenToUse: Completion of a measurable task — uploads, multi-step forms, onboarding.
meta.whenNotToUse: Indefinite waits (Spinner) or radial percentage display (out of scope).

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: A hierarchical navigation trail — links, separators, the current page, and ellipsis collapse for long paths.

meta.whenToUse: Show location in a hierarchy and navigate back up — nested pages, file trees.
meta.whenNotToUse: Primary navigation or a menu — a breadcrumb reflects location only.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A dialog that slides in from a screen edge — four sides, header/footer layout, focus trapping, animated slide.

meta.whenToUse: A panel anchored to a screen edge — filters, detail/inspector panels, slide-in nav.
meta.whenNotToUse: A centered confirmation or short form (Dialog), or a long multi-step flow (a page).

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A rich preview panel that opens on hover or focus — interactive content, four directions, forgiving delays.

meta.whenToUse: A rich optional preview of an entity — a user/agent/team card. Pass resolved content as children.
meta.whenNotToUse: Plain-text labels (Tooltip), blocking content (Dialog), or anything essential (hover-only isn't reachable on touch).

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu of actions revealed by right-click (or long-press) — items, submenus, separators, labels, shortcuts, checkbox/radio.

meta.whenToUse: Actions on right-click of a specific target — a canvas item, file row, text selection.
meta.whenNotToUse: Discoverable/touch-first surfaces (DropdownMenu with a button) or form value selection (Select).

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page navigation — previous/next, numbered page links, an ellipsis for long ranges, and the active page.

meta.whenToUse: Navigate paged content — a long list/table split across numbered pages.
meta.whenNotToUse: Infinite scroll / 'load more' feeds, or tab-style switching.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: A scroll container with custom, auto-hiding scrollbars — dual-axis, token-styled, built on Base UI ScrollArea.

meta.whenToUse: Bounded panels whose content overflows — sidebars, log viewers, modal bodies, chat histories.
meta.whenNotToUse: Whole-page scrolling, or content that already fits.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Draggable, keyboard-resizable split panes — horizontal or vertical, nestable, with an optional collapsible panel. Built on react-resizable-panels.

meta.whenToUse: User-adjustable split layouts — code editor panes, sidebar + content, inspector panels.
meta.whenNotToUse: Fixed layouts, or layouts that only need to collapse/expand (Collapsible) without a drag/resize affordance.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Styled semantic table primitives — a scrollable container plus header, body, footer, row, head, cell, caption.

meta.whenToUse: Display tabular data with header/body/footer rows — lists, comparisons, summaries.
meta.whenNotToUse: Page layout or non-tabular content — use a grid/flex layout.

items.name: status-icon
items.title: Status Icon
items.description: A small status indicator icon — todo, in progress, blocked, done — each mapping to a lucide icon and semantic color.

meta.whenToUse: Indicate the state of a task or item — todo, in progress, blocked, or done — alongside a label.
meta.whenNotToUse: Measurable progress (Progress) or generic loading (Spinner).

items.name: progress-indicator
items.title: Progress Indicator
items.description: A compact circular pie-fill progress indicator (0–100%) — a server-safe SVG glyph in circle or squircle shapes.

meta.whenToUse: A compact determinate percentage glyph — inline beside a label or metric.
meta.whenNotToUse: Indefinite waits (Spinner) or wide tasks where a linear Progress bar reads better.

items.name: truncated-text
items.title: Truncated Text
items.description: Truncate text to one line or N lines with an ellipsis, revealing the full text in a tooltip only when it overflows.

meta.whenToUse: Long values in constrained layouts — table cells, nav labels, IDs/paths.
meta.whenNotToUse: Essential action text or content that must be fully visible.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: A square, icon-only action button — a thin Button wrapper that requires an accessible label.

meta.whenToUse: A compact icon-only action — toolbar buttons, row actions, close/dismiss.
meta.whenNotToUse: Actions needing a visible text label (Button with icon) or URL navigation (link).

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copy a value to the clipboard with transient check feedback — a ghost icon button that swaps Copy → Check and fires onCopied.

meta.whenToUse: Copy a short opaque value — API key, invite link, ID, snippet — with clear confirmation.
meta.whenNotToUse: Long-form content to read/edit, or when there is no discrete value to copy.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a show/hide eye toggle and an optional live requirements checklist.

meta.whenToUse: Any password entry — login, signup, reset, settings. Use requirements for enforced rules.
meta.whenNotToUse: Non-secret text (Input) or one-time codes (OTP Input).

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A multi-slot one-time-passcode input — keyboard navigation, paste distribution, masking, disabled, built on Base UI OTP Field.

meta.whenToUse: A short fixed-length verification code — 2FA/MFA, email/SMS OTP.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-form/variable-length text (Input) or a single masked secret (Password Input).

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: A primary action joined to a dropdown of related secondary actions — one default click, plus a chevron menu.

meta.whenToUse: One primary action plus closely related variants — Save / Save as draft, Publish / Schedule.
meta.whenNotToUse: Unrelated actions (DropdownMenu), a single action (Button), or value selection (Select).

items.name: field-inline
items.title: Field Inline
items.description: Click-to-edit text — displays a value, swaps to a focused input on click, commits on Enter or blur, cancels on Escape.

meta.whenToUse: Inline-edit a single text value in place — table cells, titles, detail rows.
meta.whenNotToUse: Multi-line text, non-text inputs, or full forms with validation — use Field.

items.name: relative-time
items.title: Relative Time
items.description: Render a date as a human-relative string ("2 hours ago", "yesterday") with native Intl.RelativeTimeFormat — self-updating, with an absolute-date tooltip.

meta.whenToUse: A timestamp relative to now — comment/activity times (ago) or calendar-day grouping (day).
meta.whenNotToUse: A fixed absolute date that should never change — just format it once.

items.name: settings-row
items.title: Settings Row
items.description: A borders-only settings layout — titled sections, bordered cards, and label-plus-control rows.

meta.whenToUse: Settings/preferences screens — titled sections, bordered cards, label/description + control rows.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-form content surfaces (Card), data tables, or complex multi-field forms.

items.name: image
items.title: Image
items.description: A presentational framed image with aspect-ratio, rounding, a loading skeleton, and an error fallback.

meta.whenToUse: Display a resolved image URL with reserved aspect-ratio, a loading skeleton, and a graceful error fallback.
meta.whenNotToUse: When you must fetch/resolve the source (R2/CDN keys) — presentational; resolve URLs app-side.

items.name: notification-bell
items.title: Notification Bell
items.description: A bell icon button with an unread-count badge overlay. Presentational — the app supplies the count.

meta.whenToUse: A bell trigger surfacing an unread count in app chrome — app owns the count and handler.
meta.whenNotToUse: The notifications panel itself, or a generic count badge (Badge).

items.name: markdown-view
items.title: Markdown View
items.description: Render a markdown string to safe, token-styled HTML — headings, lists, code, blockquotes, links, GFM tables — XSS-safe, no raw HTML.

meta.whenToUse: Display user/system-authored markdown — descriptions, comments, activity — as safe token-styled prose.
meta.whenNotToUse: Editing markdown (use an editor), or when the source needs embedded raw HTML.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toast
items.description: Brief, non-blocking notifications — a token-styled Sonner toaster with success/error/warning/info variants that follows the theme.

meta.whenToUse: Brief confirmations of an action — 'Saved', 'Copied', 'Invitation sent'.
meta.whenNotToUse: Errors the user must resolve, destructive confirmations, or essential info — use inline or a Dialog.

items.name: provider
items.title: Provider
items.description: The single app-root wrapper — theme (next-themes), Sonner toasts, tooltip coordination, and text direction in one mount-once component.

meta.whenToUse: Once, around your app root (layout.tsx) — every VegaStack component below it gets dark mode, working toast() calls, shared tooltip delays, and direction context.
meta.whenNotToUse: Anywhere below the root, or a second time — the bundled Toaster is a mount-once portal; pass toaster={false} if you must render your own.

items.name: command
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: A searchable command palette — filtered, grouped items with keyboard navigation, optionally inside a ⌘K dialog.

meta.whenToUse: A keyboard-first command palette or fuzzy-search picker — global ⌘K, action launchers, searchable lists.
meta.whenNotToUse: A simple form select (Select), a small static action menu (DropdownMenu).

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The standardized header at the top of a page — back button, breadcrumb trail, title, description, actions, secondary menu, and a favorite star.

meta.whenToUse: The header band at the top of a page — title plus back/breadcrumb nav, actions, favorite.
meta.whenNotToUse: App-shell chrome (top nav/sidebar) or a section heading inside a page.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A collapsible app navigation rail — header/content/footer, labelled groups, menu items with active state, and an expand/collapse trigger.

meta.whenToUse: Primary app navigation in a dashboard/console shell — collapsible rail with grouped items.
meta.whenNotToUse: A few top-level links (horizontal nav) or transient small-viewport nav (Sheet).

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: The shared dashboard layout — a skip-linked sidebar + header + scrollable main region, composing Sidebar/SidebarTrigger into one reusable, hash-tracked shell.

meta.whenToUse: The root layout for a dashboard/console app — sidebar + header + main content, shared across every downstream VegaStack app.
meta.whenNotToUse: A marketing/docs page with no persistent nav rail, or an app that already owns an equivalent shell — compose Sidebar/PageHeader/Breadcrumb directly instead.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: A row of removable filter chips, an "Add filter" dropdown, and an optional search input — for list and table filter toolbars.

meta.whenToUse: Filter toolbars for lists/tables — active filters as removable chips + an Add-filter menu + optional search.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single search box (Input), value selection (Select), or unrelated row actions.

items.name: auto-save-input
items.title: Auto Save Input
items.description: An input that debounces edits and persists them via an async onSave, with an inline idle/saving/saved/error status.

meta.whenToUse: Settings-style fields that save on pause without a Save button — names, slugs, inline fields.
meta.whenNotToUse: Form submission with a Save button, secrets, or one-time codes.

items.name: country-select
items.title: Country Select
items.description: A searchable country combobox returning the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, with flag + name. Built on Combobox.

meta.whenToUse: Collecting a country in an address/billing form — store the ISO code.
meta.whenNotToUse: A small fixed option set (Select) or multi-select.

items.name: region-select
items.title: Region Select
items.description: A searchable combobox of states/provinces for a country, with a free-text fallback for countries with no subdivisions.

meta.whenToUse: A state/province as part of an address form, dependent on the selected country.
meta.whenNotToUse: A small country-independent option set (Select) or multi-select.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Pick a single date or a date range from a calendar popover — token-styled, keyboard-navigable, with optional quick presets.

meta.whenToUse: Selecting a single date or a range (with optional Today/Last-7-days presets) from a popover.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-form/partial dates (masked Input) or inline-only calendars (use Calendar directly).

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A swatch-triggered popover presenting a grid of preset colors — pick one, fire onValueChange, mark the selection.

meta.whenToUse: Pick a single color from a small curated set — labels, tags, calendar categories.
meta.whenNotToUse: Full-spectrum hue/saturation/alpha selection.

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji Picker
items.description: A popover with a searchable, category-grouped grid of emoji that returns the selected character via onSelect (curated set, not full Unicode).

meta.whenToUse: Lightweight emoji insertion — reactions, comments, status, icon selection.
meta.whenNotToUse: A complete Unicode emoji browser — extend the embedded set or use a library.

items.name: data-list
items.title: Data List
items.description: A generic, typed data table — configurable columns, row selection, sortable headers, plus loading and empty states.

meta.whenToUse: A list of records as a table with typed columns, selection, click-to-sort, and loading/empty states.
meta.whenNotToUse: A board/kanban view (deferred — needs dnd) or a simple static table (use Table).

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A compact anatomy row for list/feed content — media, title, description, actions, groupable with dividers.

meta.whenToUse: A row of structured content in a feed, list, or panel — a person, file, notification, or settings link — with optional media and trailing actions.
meta.whenNotToUse: Tabular/sortable data with columns (use Table or DataList) or a zero-data placeholder (use Empty).

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: A themed Recharts wrapper — token-only series colors (--chart-1…--chart-8), a bordered tooltip/legend, and Recharts' own built-in keyboard + screen-reader layer.

meta.whenToUse: Visualizing series data (trends, comparisons, breakdowns) with a Line/Bar/Area chart that needs to match the design system's theme automatically in light and dark.
meta.whenNotToUse: Tabular/exact-value data a user needs to read precisely (Table), a single KPI number (a stat tile), or a progress/completion metric (Progress / ProgressIndicator).

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated Number
items.description: A number display that tweens from its previous value to a new one on every change — Intl.NumberFormat-aware (currency/percent/compact), instant under reduced motion, the dashboard stat-card counter.

meta.whenToUse: A numeric stat/metric that updates over time and should visually count/tween to its new value — dashboard KPIs, live prices, counters.
meta.whenNotToUse: A static number that never changes after render — just render it directly; the tween machinery adds nothing.

items.name: use-animation-replay
items.title: useAnimationReplay / useShakeOnInvalid
items.description: Replay a mount-style CSS animation (e.g. motion-shake) on demand via class-toggle, without remounting the element — preserves focus/caret/selection on form controls. Includes useShakeOnInvalid, the auto-shake-on-invalid-transition convenience built on it.

meta.whenToUse: Replaying a motion-* utility on a user action (error shake, retry pop, etc.), especially on an element that might be focused (form controls) where a key-remount would steal focus.
meta.whenNotToUse: One-shot mount animations that never need to replay — just apply the motion-* class directly.

items.name: use-mobile
items.title: useIsMobile
items.description: SSR-safe viewport-width hook — reports whether the viewport is below a breakpoint (default 768px), live across resizes.

meta.whenToUse: Switching a layout between desktop and mobile treatments (e.g. Sidebar's rail vs. Sheet mode) based on real viewport width.
meta.whenNotToUse: CSS-only responsive layout — reach for a Tailwind breakpoint utility instead when no JS branching is needed.

items.name: text-edit
items.title: Text Edit
items.description: A Tiptap-based rich-text editor with a compact, token-styled toolbar (bold, italic, strike, heading, lists, blockquote, code) — controlled HTML in, HTML out. Collaboration deferred.

meta.whenToUse: Short-to-medium rich text — comments, descriptions, release notes — via controlled HTML.
meta.whenNotToUse: Plain single-line input (Input) or collaborative real-time docs (deferred text-edit-collab).

items.name: dashboard-01
items.title: Dashboard 01
items.description: An AI-platform dashboard starter page — sidebar nav, stat cards, a usage chart, and a recent-activity list, built entirely from existing VegaStack components.

meta.whenToUse: Starting a new AI-platform-style dashboard route — pull once and own it (not hash-tracked/re-pulled like app-shell).
meta.whenNotToUse: You just need the shared shell mechanics across many routes — install app-shell/sidebar directly instead.

items.name: marketing-surface
items.title: Marketing Surface
items.description: Opts a subtree into the brand's dark warm ground, independent of the page's .dark class.

meta.whenToUse: Wrap a marketing hero or section band so it renders the dark brand ground even when the surrounding product page is light.
meta.whenNotToUse: Anything that needs a Base UI portal (Select, Dialog, Popover, …) to inherit the dark ground — portals mount outside this subtree.

items.name: section-header
items.title: Section Header
items.description: A marketing section lead-in — mono uppercase eyebrow, display-scale title, optional description.

meta.whenToUse: Lead in a marketing section with an eyebrow + display title + optional description.
meta.whenNotToUse: Product UI headings — use text-h1…h4 directly; SectionHeader is marketing-scale.

items.name: figure-frame
items.title: Figure Frame
items.description: A sharp-cornered media frame with an optional mono FIG-annotation caption.

meta.whenToUse: Frame a single screenshot, video, or live demo on a marketing surface.
meta.whenNotToUse: Product-surface media — product radii/framing stay unchanged (6/8/12 scale).

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A dark mono command block with a phosphor prompt glyph and a composed copy button.

meta.whenToUse: Install snippets and short, copyable command sequences on a marketing surface.
meta.whenNotToUse: Long-form code samples — use a standard code block.

items.name: logo-row
items.title: Logo Row
items.description: A muted logo/wordmark strip — alpha-dimmed at rest, restoring on hover for linked items.

meta.whenToUse: A trust bar of partner/integration wordmarks (text only — never real, uncleared logos).
meta.whenNotToUse: A single featured partner/customer — use a dedicated callout instead.

items.name: testimonial
items.title: Testimonial
items.description: A pull-quote — a serif-italic quote over a mono uppercase attribution line.

meta.whenToUse: A short customer/user pull-quote on a marketing surface.
meta.whenNotToUse: Long-form endorsements — this is a display-scale pull-quote, not a case study.

items.name: staggered-text-reveal
items.title: Staggered Text Reveal
items.description: Display text whose words rise in on mount, staggered one motion-enter-up step apart — CSS-only.

meta.whenToUse: A hero headline's entrance, composed inside a real heading element.
meta.whenNotToUse: Body copy, or anywhere the entrance would replay on every re-render/scroll.

items.name: particle-field
items.title: Particle Field
items.description: A deterministic, very-low-alpha canvas field of drifting phosphor dots — hero atmosphere only.

meta.whenToUse: Subtle hero-background atmosphere over a dark marketing ground.
meta.whenNotToUse: A focal element, or more than one instance in the same viewport.
